Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Recap: You’re evaluating Redwood for inference serving across your analytics platform; initial scope 2 dedicated nodes for Q4 POC.
- Procurement ask: confirm whether Acme will pay via PO/net terms or card (corporate card). This impacts our billing flow and how we provide a vendor packet.
- Paperwork we can provide today: vendor setup packet, Redwood W-9, sample invoice.
- Marketplace: we support marketplace listings (AWS, GCP) if you prefer procurement via marketplace procurement. Interested?

Can you confirm: (1) PO vs card, (2) whether procurement needs our bank details/W-9 attached to a vendor portal, and (3) the name/email for the person who will upload vendor docs to your portal?

I attached the vendor packet and W-9 for your review. Happy to jump on a short call with procurement if helpful.

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary. Looping in our procurement email. Quick answers: 

1) We prefer PO / net-30 for anything above $10k, so likely PO for the dedicated nodes.
2) Procurement runs a vendor portal where we upload W-9 and bank details. They will need the vendor packet and bank routing info.
3) Primary contact is Hannah Li (hannah.li@acme-analytics.com). She will create the vendor record and request any missing items.

Can you send the bank details and a small sample invoice that our AP team can use to validate? Also confirm whether Redwood requires a master services agreement signature or if we can proceed on order form + SOW for the POC.

Thanks — Alex
